items.title: VELTRIX 0.8.0 is available
items.summary: The latest development build adds the new Minecraft launch pipeline, Fabric preparation, game logs and improved launch diagnostics.

items.title: Official VELTRIX project page launched
items.summary: The public project page now contains launcher information, authentication details, project status, news and the current download.

items.title: Minecraft Services approval in progress
items.summary: Microsoft OAuth and Xbox/XSTS authentication are integrated. The VELTRIX application is being submitted for Minecraft Services approval.
